name: Local Pull Request Orchestration Workflow
description: Fail-safe PR checkout, terminal verification, multi-pass code evaluation, and human-gated review publishing.

steps.name: Pre-flight workspace snapshot and dirty stashing
Fetch PR metadata, checkout branch, and filter noise
Trace impacted upstream and downstream modules
Execute static analysis, linters, tests, and smoke build
Synthesize review report, prompt user, and restore workspace

acceptance_criteria: Pre-flight snapshot recorded and dirty state stashed
PR branch checked out without untracked file loss
Lockfiles and minified assets filtered from review
Terminal verification executed and exit codes triaged
Code evaluated across 7 software engineering standards
Findings categorized using Conventional Comments syntax
Review artifact persisted and workspace cleanly restored
